camel_example: aliyun esa ListWafRulesets --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1 --Phase http_bot --QueryArgs http_bot --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --SiteVersion 0
description_en: Lists the rulesets under the current WAF execution phase. Queries basic information and status of rulesets with paging support
description_zh: 列举出当前WAF运行阶段下的规则集列表，通过此接口查看分页查询规则集的基本信息和状态
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-waf-rulesets --site-id 1 --site-version 0 --phase http_bot --query-args http_bot --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListWafRulesets

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en:
The WAF rule execution phase. Valid values:
http_whitelist: whitelist rules
http_custom: custom rules
http_managed: managed rules
http_anti_scan: scan protection rules
http_ratelimit: frequency control rules
ip_access_rule: IP access rules
http_bot: advanced mode bots
http_security_level_rule: security rules
parameters.help_zh:
WAF规则运行阶段。
http_whitelist：白名单规则
http_custom：自定义规则
http_managed：托管规则
http_anti_scan：扫描防护规则
http_ratelimit：频次控制规则
ip_access_rule：IP访问规则
http_bot：高级模式Bots
http_security_level_rule：安全规则
parameters.name: phase

fields.help_en: The fuzzy match string for the ruleset ID, ruleset name, rule ID, or rule name
fields.help_zh: 模糊查询规则集ID、规则集名称、规则ID、规则名称
fields.name: any_like

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to sort the results in descending order
fields.name: desc

fields.help_en: The fuzzy match string for the ruleset name
fields.name: name_like

fields.help_en: The column by which to sort the results
fields.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The query parameters, passed in JSON format, including various filter conditions
parameters.help_zh: 查询参数，以JSON格式传递，包含各种筛选条件
parameters.name: query_args

parameters.help_en: The page number. Specifies the current page number for paging queries
parameters.help_zh: 页面号码，分页查询时指定当前页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The page size. Specifies the number of records per page for paging queries
parameters.help_zh: 页面大小，分页查询时指定每页的记录数量
parameters.name: page_size
